out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed unsalted butter (53F) on food cart at the cook line, pork fat (71F) on grill top, and cut lettuce in a plastic bag at 47F in the prep top refrigerator at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC placed unsalted butter under refrigeration to cool butter back down to 41F within a remainder of 2 hours. PIC discarded pork fat. PIC transferred cut lettuce to a container and placed inside a refrigerator to cool down in 2 hours or less.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Observed large batches of cooked soup sitting out at room temperature. When measured with a calibrated food thermometer, the soups were anywhere between 92f-125f after 1-1.75 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. PIC was asked to reheat the soups to 165f and start the cooling process over. PIC was educated on proper methods to cool down hot foods rapidly. This included use of ice wands, small/uncovered portions, and freezers. Ensure continued correction before the follow up.

For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Please provide a label for all food items once removed from original container. violations.corrective_action: Cloths shall not be used for any other purposes. For example, cloths shall not be placed under cutting boards to prevent the boards from sliding while in use. out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed handles used to dispense food in contact with dry goods.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC was educated to ensure all handles are stored above food before the follow up.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: observed squeeze bottles of soy sauce and oil were not labeled throughout the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all working containers throughout the kitchen.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Adequate methods are not being used to control pests. Observed 3 live cockroaches on food contact surfaces of cook line and dish area and mouse droppings on the food preparation surfaces of cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC contacted a licensed pest control technician during inspection. PIC will deep clean all affected surfaces of kitchen before follow-up inspection. Follow-up inspection will be conducted upon request.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead mouse carcasses observed in downstairs dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. PIC will remove all deceased pests before follow-up inspection.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: Observed an employee using the same pair of tongs to prepare both raw pork and raw chicken.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC trained staff on proper cooking processes for raw animal foods of different types.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Pealed garlic manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of pickled radish in 2 DR upright at expo and pickled cooked carrots in 2 DR prep unit (L) at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC discarded picked radish and pickled cooked carrots.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: Observed cut and cleaned papaya stored in direct contact with shopping bag in 2 DR prep unit (L) at cook line and cabbage stored in shopping bag in 2 DR prep cooler (R) at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC discarded shopping bags and possibly contaminated papaya and cabbage.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: back wall of cook line, plumbing underneath dish machine, walls of kitchen prep areas.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Follow-up inspection will be conducted upon request.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the wall of stairwell and ceiling of downstairs prep area is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC will repair all holes in walls and ceilings before follow-up inspection is conducted.
